I answered Pree in our DM: send the Driftwood truck to Dock 32.

That comes from her own DM to me on Oct 14, where she said Dock 32 is the dock she uses for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Driftwood project. In the same message she listed her other two docks: Gate 45 for Corvid (Marrow Fieldworks) and Door 16 for Bittern (Tansley Parcel). I included those so she can check she isn't booking the wrong one.

I only used what Pree can already see: our DM and #central-team, which she's a member of. #central-team has nothing newer about Driftwood docks. I took no other action.
